    IsLocallyCertified C R π n d} where

    ⟨fun d => Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_refl d.1,
     fun h => h.symm, fun h h' => h.trans h'⟩

(`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2): locally certified local-equation systems of
degree `n` up to divisor equality. This is the carrier on which the divisor functor is
a Zariski sheaf — the globally certified `DivFam` remains the building block. -/

ADDENDUM 2 §4 left exactly one question and called it a design decision an agent should not take

consequence is a determinate repair with a costed work breakdown. This addendum supersedes

### 1. The answer: the `Z(♦)` chart does NOT confine its divisors

**(a) The seed carries no exactness datum, and cannot be given one honestly.**
`ThetaGeneratorSeed` (`Picard/DivSchemeFamily.lean:74`) has exactly five fields — `side`, `h`,
`mem_basicOpen`, `sec`, `sec_mem` — and `IsGenerator` (:129) exactly two — `dvd`,
`fibre_regular`. None mentions Θ, pole order or a chart. Every universal instantiation of
`side` picks an ARBITRARY chart containing the point (`seedUniv`,
`Picard/DivSchemeSeedUnivGen.lean:283`, `side := (exists_seedPoint …).choose`; `seedUniv'`,
`Picard/DivSchemeRedesignSeedUniv.lean:180`; `pointwiseSide`,
`Picard/DivSchemeSeedUnivPointwise.lean:88`), so a point of `π⁻¹(∞)` is legal everywhere.

**(b) ADDENDUM 2 §4's "tractable half" is not a half, and its argument is circular.**
Θ = `fiberWeilDivisor π` is supported on `V₀ ∖ V₁` (`RiemannRoch/FLVFiberToolkit.lean:292`,
:311, :254), i.e. set-theoretically **Θ = V₁ᶜ**. So "`supportLocus ∩ π⁻¹(∞) = ∅`" IS the
disjunct `supportLocus ⊆ V₁` of the verdict — a whole side of the conclusion, not a tractable
half of it. And the route is circular: `IsGenerator.dvd` forces `eqn z` to generate `K·𝒪` on
its piece, so `supportLocus` is the base locus of `K`, and "a generator of exact pole order `a`
exists at `y ∈ Θ`" holds iff the base locus misses `y`. Premise = conclusion.

**(c) There is an explicit counterexample, and no Zariski shrink of the base evades it.**
Over `k[t]`, on `C = P¹`, `π = id`, take the degree-2 form

  `F = t·X² + X·Y + t·Y²`,   `D = Z(F) ⊆ P¹ × A¹_t`.

The coefficients `(t, 1, t)` generate the unit ideal, so `D` is a relative effective Cartier
divisor, finite flat of degree 2. `F(1,0) = F(0,1) = t`, so the fibre `D₀ = Z(XY) = {0, ∞}`
meets BOTH vertical fibres. In the chart `Y = 1`, `F = t(x²+1) + x` is degree 1 in `t` with
coprime coefficients, hence irreducible in `k[x,t]`; the only point over `Y = 0` is `(∞, 0)`,
which lies in the closure (`t = -x/(x²+1) → 0` as `x → ∞`). So `D` is IRREDUCIBLE. `D → A¹_t`
is finite surjective, so over every nonempty open `U ⊆ Spec k[t]`, `D_U` is a nonempty open of

has a member containing `t = 0`, and over that member `D` is connected and meets both vertical

framing the `B`-restricted window.  Identify with `congrAmbient` of the packaged point
(`Module.Grassmannian.ext`), then K4 (`map_congrAmbient`) + the tower transport. -/
theorem map_window_frame_toSubmodule {r : ℕ}
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin r) k
      ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤))
    (F : DivFam C S π g) (β : T →ₐ[k] B)

    (y : Grassmannian.grFunctorAff k (Fin r → k) g T)

    rw [hy, congrAmbient_toSubmodule, divFamWindowGr_toSubmodule,
      ← DivFam.window_mapAlg hπ g hO hχ a ha1 hMa T F]
  rw [hyeq, map_congrAmbient β b.equivFun (divFamWindowGr hπ g hO hχ a ha1 hMa F T),
    map_divFamWindowGr_algHom hπ g hO hχ a ha1 hMa F β hβ,
    congrAmbient_toSubmodule, divFamWindowGr_toSubmodule,
    ← DivFam.window_mapAlg hπ g hO hχ a ha1 hMa B F]

23	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chartLocus` — `{q | every datum with fibre class `c` has a witness

27	  the witness predicate is class-intrinsic, quantifying over all data representing `c`
28	  and over some datum representing `c` give the same locus.  (Every class IS represented,
29	  by `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.exists_cechPicClass_eq`.)

73	def chartLocus (c : (relCurve C B).CechPic) : Set (PrimeSpectrum B) :=
74	  {q : PrimeSpectrum B | ∀ D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π,
75	    D.cechPicClass = c → D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing q.asIdeal.ResidueField}

78	    q ∈ chartLocus π c ↔ ∀ D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π,
79	      D.cechPicClass = c → D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
80	  Iff.rfl

83	sound and complete test for membership of the chart locus.  This is the class-intrinsicity
84	of the witness predicate, `hasWitnessH1Vanishing_congr_of_cechPicClass_eq`, in the form
85	the consumers use. -/
86	theorem mem_chartLocus_iff_of_datum {c : (relCurve C B).CechPic}
87	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π) (hD : D.cechPicClass = c) (q : PrimeSpectrum B) :
88	    q ∈ chartLocus π c ↔ D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing q.asIdeal.ResidueField := by
89	  refine ⟨fun h => h D hD, fun h D' hD' => ?_⟩
90	  refine (D'.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_congr_of_cechPicClass_eq D
91	    q.asIdeal.ResidueField ?_).mpr h
92	  exact congrArg (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B q.asIdeal.ResidueField))
93	    (hD'.trans hD.symm)

96	some datum, and the witness predicate does not depend on which. -/
97	theorem mem_chartLocus_iff_exists (c : (relCurve C B).CechPic) (q : PrimeSpectrum B) :
98	    q ∈ chartLocus π c ↔ ∃ D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π,
99	      D.cechPicClass = c ∧ D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing q.asIdeal.ResidueField := by
100	  obtain ⟨D₀, hD₀⟩ := BasicOpenCocycleDatum.exists_cechPicClass_eq (C := C) (π := π) c
101	  refine ⟨fun h => ⟨D₀, hD₀, h D₀ hD₀⟩, fun ⟨D, hD, h⟩ => ?_⟩
102	  exact (mem_chartLocus_iff_of_datum D hD q).mpr h

114	  obtain ⟨D₀, hD₀⟩ := BasicOpenCocycleDatum.exists_cechPicClass_eq (C := C) (π := π) c
115	  have hset : chartLocus π c
116	      = {q : PrimeSpectrum B |
117	          ∃ W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k q.asIdeal.ResidueField).left).CurveDivisor,
118	            Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass q.asIdeal.ResidueField W
119	                = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B q.asIdeal.ResidueField)
120	                    D₀.cechPicClass
121	              ∧ Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
122	                  ((C ⊗ overSpec k q.asIdeal.ResidueField).left.divisorSheaf
123	                    q.asIdeal.ResidueField W) 1)} :=
124	    Set.ext fun q => mem_chartLocus_iff_of_datum D₀ hD₀ q
125	  rw [hset]
126	  exact D₀.isOpen_setOf_exists_witness_h1_vanishing hπ

29	  its naturality `homEquiv_comp` against `pic0Map`, and `abelElement_map_point`.
